input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser splits the uploaded text on `"\n"` only (see `src/ingest/parser.ts`), so files with Windows-style CRLF line endings end up with a stray `\r` on each line/column. Since finance's new export tool runs on Windows and likely emits CRLF, the header and row splitting goes wrong, triggering the `errors.rowShape` "Malformed row" error on row 1. The parser needs to normalize/strip `\r` (e.g. split on `/\r\n|\n/` or trim each line) before comparing column counts.
